These BSD-licensed NVIDIA R36.5 USB scripts and units are unmodified test
fixtures; their original license notices are retained. Generated MAC-address
files, device identities and runtime state are not included. Tests use synthetic
udev rule text rather than redistribute proprietary NVIDIA rule contents.

The production audit in products/JAJ/fastboot/usb-udev-audit.json stores hashes
and relative paths only. All three staged boards were checked read-only against
that inventory before enabling the opt-in transform.
